"""Root-owned archive copy. Dry run by default; all guards run before --apply writes."""

import argparse
from pathlib import Path

from common import (
    DOSSIER,
    ROOT,
    bind,
    check_inputs,
    external_new,
    input_config,
    now,
    read,
    relative,
    verify,
    write,
)


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    ap.add_argument("--plan", required=True, type=Path)
    ap.add_argument("--receipt", required=True, type=Path)
    ap.add_argument("--apply", action="store_true")
    args = ap.parse_args()
    receipt = external_new(args.receipt)
    from lineage import verify_archive_plan

    plan, cfg, adoption, gates, preservation, assessment, tested = verify_archive_plan(args.plan)
    verify(plan["config"])
    check_inputs(input_config(plan["config"]["path"]))
    destinations = []
    for row in plan["mappings"]:
        verify(row["original"])
        verify(row["prepared"])
        dest = ROOT / relative(row["destination"])
        assert dest.is_relative_to(ROOT / DOSSIER / "final-gates")
        assert not dest.exists() and not dest.is_symlink()
        assert not any(p.is_symlink() for p in dest.parents if p.is_relative_to(ROOT))
        if row["mode"] == "lossless_utf8":
            assert (
                read(row["prepared"]["path"])["text"].encode()
                == Path(row["original"]["path"]).read_bytes()
            )
        elif row["mode"] in {"exact", "credential_header_projection"}:
            assert row["prepared"]["sha256"] == row["original"]["sha256"]
        else:
            raise AssertionError("Unknown archive mode")
        destinations.append((dest, row))
    if args.apply:
        for dest, row in destinations:
            dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            with dest.open("xb") as stream:
                stream.write(Path(row["prepared"]["path"]).read_bytes())
    result = {
        "status": "archived" if args.apply else "dry_run_passed",
        "at": now(),
        "plan": bind(args.plan),
        "files": [
            {"relative_path": str(dest.relative_to(ROOT)), **bind(dest)} for dest, _ in destinations
        ]
        if args.apply
        else [],
        "pending": "native inspect, saved review/history, exact extra-file b"
        "indings and final preservation",
    }
    write(receipt, result)
    print({"status": result["status"], "receipt": bind(receipt)})


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
